axioms.title: Oriented twelve-port observer screen
axioms.informal: There exists an observer patch net on an oriented spherical screen. At every finite resolution, each local carrier has twelve primitive boundary ports. The ports form the vertices of an oriented triangular boundary with 30 edges and 20 faces, combinatorially the boundary of an icosahedron: five edges meet each port, the neighbors of each port form a five-cycle, and every edge belongs to two oppositely oriented faces. Carriers join through typed seams and coherent triple overlaps, refine to an oriented spherical support, and expose local state, readback, records, repair moves, and checkpoints. Their complete infinitesimal port response is represented faithfully on a finite-dimensional unitary response space and is closed under the commutators generated by ordered response composition.
axioms.formal_concise: For every regulator r in a directed system (R, <=) there is a typed observer-screen object N_r = (P_r, A_r, R_r, I_r, U_r, C_r, N_r, S_r, b_r): a finite patch/overlap category with an isotone local algebra net; central record algebras; interface, update, and checkpoint types; a federation C_r of finite local carriers, each carrying twelve primitive pairwise-orthogonal central port projections summing to one and a boundary packet K = (P, E, F, o) with |P| = 12, |E| = 30, |F| = 20, degree-five ports with five-cycle links, and coherently oriented two-face edges, combinatorially isomorphic to the icosahedral boundary complex with no preferred labels; seam algebras with unital restriction maps and coherent triple-overlap cocycles forming the nerve N_r; a declared finite edge-midpoint refinement support S_r with an orientation-preserving realization into the two-sphere, mesh tending to zero, and a source-bound degree-one simplicial bridge b_r from the nerve; and refinement maps commuting with routing, quotienting, incidence, records, checkpoints, and support projection. Each carrier also has V = R[P], a finite-dimensional complex Hilbert response space H, and a faithful real-linear map D: V -> u(H). Its image g = D(V) is commutator-closed and complete for the declared quotient-visible infinitesimal port response, the pairing -Tr(D(v)D(w)) is positive definite, and the response construction is natural under admissible presentation equivalence and refinement.

axioms.title: Observer agreement
axioms.informal: Observers operating on the screen agree on the meaning of the data they jointly interpret. Every proper recharting of a complete carrier can be performed by their own reversible overlap response rather than by an external relabeling.
axioms.formal_concise: For each regulator r, the interpretation map J_r from observer-accessible data to operational meanings is natural with respect to every visible overlap restriction, recharting, seam translation, higher-overlap map, federation map, and refinement map. Accepted reversible overlap transports form a groupoid O_r. For each complete carrier chart o, the map from closed overlap paths Hol_r(o) onto the orientation-preserving incidence automorphisms Aut+(K) is surjective. For every proper carrier automorphism a, A2 supplies one closed path gamma_a and one projective implementer [U_a] in PU(H), natural on port response by Ad_[U_a] D(v) = D(a.v). The implementer is endogenous: [U_a] = [g_a c_a] for g_a in the identity component generated by exp(tD(v)) and c_a in the unitary centralizer of D(V). Path composition is projective and natural under refinement.

axioms.title: Conditional maximum randomness
axioms.informal: Everything that observer agreement leaves unconstrained is maximally random.
axioms.formal_concise: At finite regulator r, a state is a compatible family of local normalized states on the accessible algebra net. Let K_r be the nonempty convex set of such families satisfying the finite observer-visible constraints supplied by A1 and A2, generated by an A1 observable and constraint grammar through which every A2-visible constraint provably factors. A3 supplies an exact reference and aggregation rule: a compatible local reference family tau_r, a finite A1-generated observer cover G_r whose restriction map is injective on K_r, and strictly positive exact weights w_{r,P} from quotient-visible A1 data, natural under admissible presentation equivalence. Equivalently at smooth points, no nonzero feasible tangent is invisible to the entire cover. The realized state is the information projection rho_r = argmin over K_r of the weighted sum of finite-algebra Umegaki relative entropies D(rho_P || tau_P) over the cover. When every local reference density is identity-proportional in its declared trace, this equals weighted local entropy maximization.
